root_cause: Recovery workflow_dispatch normalized github.run_id as prNumber, causing Required test preflight to call GitHub pulls/{run_id} instead of the intended pull request.
prevention: Only use an explicit pull request number as PR identity for workflow_dispatch.
Never treat github.run_id as a pull request number.
Bind explicit dispatch PR identity to immutable PR base/head refs when provided.
Fail closed when dispatch has no PR identity rather than fabricating one.
